notes: Delete mirroring literature_arts-replace-0014: removes the work's form. The replace record's inheritance and chain queries are phrased around the replacement class (verse, narrative poem); around the original class they would not discriminate under delete (the class 'novel' gives no firm property: verse novels exist, and fiction already follows from the fantasy genre). So the determinate slots compare the work's form with two well-known novels, which needs the deleted fact. Worlds carry over from the replace record (verifier, round 2): the structure stored by name (w1) keeps the chapters and the opening; the structure reached only through the form (w2) is lost with it. A by-name 'written in prose' has 0 exact hits, so it is no route around the deletion.
